annotations.title: Live availability: can this be bought or booked right now?

description: Product availability and price check: is it in stock and buyable right now, at what price, in which options (sizes, colours, dates, rooms), which option matches the variant you name, quantity and ship-to eligibility where the page states them, with evidence and a checked_at stamp. Reads any product or booking page (schema.org, Open Graph, Shopify JSON; a browser only when needed). Input: url; optional variant, quantity, ship_to. $0.50 per call. Returns: available, availability, price, currency, options[], matched_option, quantity_ok, ship_to_ok, shipping, eligibility_notes[], evidence[], source, confidence, checked_at.

language.description: Optional answer language, BCP-47 (en, ja, pt-BR). Default: the input's.

ship_to.description: Optional: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the order ships to.

url.description: The product, listing or booking page.

variant.description: Optional: the option you want, in words (size 9 natural black; double room 12 Oct; economy).
